biotools.summary: FluoAnalysis is an open-source MATLAB toolbox designed for analyzing calcium imaging and electrophysiological data, particularly focusing on oscillatory signals in astrocytic and neuronal networks. It offers both GUI-based and command-line approaches for data processing, cell classification, spectral analysis, and report generation.
